targets.query: SELECT "run_number" FROM "dunedaq.drunc.opmon.RunInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND $timeFilter AND run_number>0
SELECT  last("hardware_configured") FROM "dunedaq.cibmodules.opmon.CIBModuleInfo" WHERE $timeFilter AND session='${session}'
SELECT  last(hardware_running) FROM "dunedaq.cibmodules.opmon.CIBModuleInfo" WHERE $timeFilter AND  session='${session}'

SELECT  last(num_control_messages_sent) FROM "dunedaq.cibmodules.opmon.CIBModuleInfo" WHERE $timeFilter AND  session='${session}' AND application=~/${application}/ GROUP BY element, time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT  last(num_control_responses_received) FROM "dunedaq.cibmodules.opmon.CIBModuleInfo" WHERE $timeFilter AND  session='${session}' AND application=~/${application}/ GROUP BY element, time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT  mean(average_buffer_occupancy) FROM "dunedaq.cibmodules.opmon.CIBModuleInfo" WHERE $timeFilter AND  session='${session}' AND application=~/${application}/ GROUP BY element, time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum(partial) FROM (SELECT  last(num_total_triggers_received) AS partial FROM "dunedaq.cibmodules.opmon.CIBModuleInfo" WHERE $timeFilter AND session='${session}' AND application=~/${application}/ GROUP BY element, time($__interval) fill(null) ) GROUP BY time($__interval)

SELECT  last(num_total_triggers_received) AS partial FROM "dunedaq.cibmodules.opmon.CIBModuleInfo" WHERE $timeFilter AND session='${session}' AND application=~/${application}/ GROUP BY element, time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last(failed_to_send_hsi_events_counter), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.cibmodules.opmon.CIBModuleInfo" WHERE $timeFilter AND  session='${session}' AND application=~/${application}/ GROUP BY element, time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT mean("rate_payloads_consumed")*1000 FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.DataHandlerInfo" WHERE "session" = '${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

SELECT mean("num_buffer_elements") FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.LatencyBufferInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element" fill(null)

SELECT sum("data") FROM ( SELECT mean("num_buffer_elements") AS "data" FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.LatencyBufferInfo" WHERE  "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element" fill(null) ) GROUP BY time($__interval)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_buffer_cleanups")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/  AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_payloads_overwritten")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.DataHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/  AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("tot_request_response_time")/sum("num_requests_handled") FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND "num_requests_handled">0 AND  $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("tot_request_response_time")/sum("num_requests_handled") FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND "num_requests_handled">0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "element", time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT min("min_request_response_time") FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND "num_requests_handled">0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT max("max_request_response_time") FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND "num_requests_handled">0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("num_requests_waiting") FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_requests")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.DataHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_requests_found")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_requests_delayed")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_requests_bad")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_requests_old_window")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_requests_timed_out")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_requests_uncategorized")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_buffer_cleanups")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/  AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
